properties.description: The four tests of crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_relation_is_found_by_a_query_in_a_persons_words.rs (in the in_memory test program) against the relation corpus crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/fixtures/find_tools_relation_corpus.json: each relation question finds an accepted relation among find_tools' `relations`; each known miss still misses; a relation hit is marked as a relation (no `tool` key, `kind` begins "relation"), names the types it joins and the call that draws it (typed tool first where one exists, create_edge with its edge_type always); every reply's `what_joins` names describe_schema with `from` and `to`. The tool half is held by the existing corpus tests (every_tool_is_found_by_a_query_in_the_users_words, find_tools_ranks_what_the_query_means, a_field_term_finds_the_type_that_holds_it), which must stay green.
